name: Grand Theft Auto VI
format: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S
digest: Launch November 19, 2026. Standard edition is $79.99 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Digital pre-load starts November 12, 2026. The physical box is a download code, not a disc, and is scheduled from November 12, 2026. Pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.
photoAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI official cover art

name: Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition
format: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S
digest: Ultimate Edition is $99.99 and adds the Ultimate Edition upgrade on top of the standard game. Take-Two says a physical Ultimate Edition box is not sold. Pre-orders before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.
photoAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI official cover art

name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
format: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, PlayStation 5
digest: Standard Edition is $49.99 and includes the base game. Global launch was July 28, 2026 at 8am PDT, July 29 in Japan and some Asia-Pacific markets. Also on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.
photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved official key art

name: Halo: Campaign Evolved Premium Edition
format: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, PlayStation 5
digest: Premium Edition is $69.99. It includes up to five days of early access beginning July 23, 2026, the Alpha Halo Armory Pack, and the digital story and art collection. Launch day is July 28, 2026.
photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved official key art

name: Halo: Campaign Evolved Collector's Edition
format: Xbox Series X, PlayStation 5, Steam
digest: Collector's Edition is $199.99 and includes a Steelbook, a 12-inch Master Chief statue, an LED Cortana chip, concept-art prints, and a disc for Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5. Steam is a code. Halo Support says it is sold out with no restock planned. Early access began July 23, 2026.
photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved Collector's Edition box

name: Gears of War: E-Day
format: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, Game Pass
digest: Standard pre-order is $69.99. Xbox Wire dates the global release to October 6, 2026. Included with Game Pass.
photoAlt: Gears of War: E-Day official image from Xbox Wire

name: Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition
format: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, Game Pass
digest: Premium Edition pre-order is $99.99 on the Xbox Store. The global game date on Xbox Wire is October 6, 2026. The Collector's Edition, not this digital premium listing, is the October 1 early-access box.

dateLabel: October 1, 2026 early access · game launches October 6, 2026
name: Gears of War: E-Day Collector's Edition
format: Xbox Series X, Steam
digest: Collector's Edition is $299.99. It includes the Premium Edition on an Xbox Series X disc, a Steelbook, a 15-inch Marcus and Dom statue, replica COG tags, and an art print. Early access is October 1, 2026. The game's global release is October 6, 2026. Quantities are limited.
photoAlt: Gears of War: E-Day Collector's Edition

format: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, Nintendo Switch 2
digest: Standard Edition is $59.99 and includes the game plus the Survivor Outfit pre-order bonus. PlayStation Blog dates the PS5 launch to February 12, 2027, and February 13 in Japan, Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. The publisher also lists Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2.
photoAlt: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis key art

format: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam

photoAlt: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis key art

format: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam
digest: The publisher lists a Collector's Edition with a premium steel case, a Lara Croft versus T-Rex statue, a mini art book, a pin, and a talisman keychain, on top of the Deluxe Edition. The same page does not state a USD price. Switch 2 pre-orders were not open on that page.
